lead: Marnau uses both, and people often ask why it does not pick one. Each method fails in a way the other does not.

points.title: Sensors never miss a night, storm or holiday.
15-minute values show short events that rounds miss.
Once a mast stands, readings cost almost nothing.
A drifting probe gives plausible but wrong data.
Measures only four properties, nothing biological.
Each sample is lab-checked on the same day.
12 rounds cost more than running all sensors.
Rounds happen by day, in fair weather only.
